subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's in these airline reviews — I'm not sure which aspect is most worth analyzing.

judge.implied_focus: The internal coherence/reliability of each review's ratings together with its dominant dissatisfaction driver — i.e., how self-consistent a review is (across sub-ratings, overall rating, and text tone) and which single aspect it complains about most.

per_column.name: rating_consistency
per_column.rationale: Flags whether a review's sub-ratings/overall cohere; a direct facet of the 'review coherence/reliability' focus.

per_column.name: primary_complaint
per_column.rationale: Identifies the dominant complaint aspect (service/seat/etc.), directly answering 'which aspect is worth analyzing', though ~64% NULL limits coverage.

per_column.name: aspect_variance
per_column.rationale: Measures spread across the aspect ratings; a coherent facet of internal rating consistency.

per_column.name: sentiment_mismatch
per_column.rationale: Compares text tone vs numeric rating; extends the coherence/reliability concept to text-vs-score agreement.

per_column.name: rating_consistency.1
per_column.rationale: Verbatim duplicate of rating_consistency; adds no analytical information and signals mechanical/broken output.

per_column.name: primary_complaint.1
per_column.rationale: Verbatim duplicate of primary_complaint; pure redundancy.

per_column.name: aspect_variance.1
per_column.rationale: Verbatim duplicate of aspect_variance; pure redundancy.

per_column.name: sentiment_mismatch.1
per_column.rationale: Verbatim duplicate of sentiment_mismatch; pure redundancy.

judge.rationale: The four UNIQUE columns do cohere around a single inferable focus: the internal consistency/reliability of a review's ratings (rating_consistency, aspect_variance, sentiment_mismatch) plus the dominant complaint driver (primary_complaint). That is a genuine, non-trivial focus an analyst could act on — e.g., segment on 'inconsistent' reviews or drill into 'service' as the top complaint — so coherence and actionability are moderate-to-good, not vacuous sentiment/length features. However, structure_quality is heavily penalised: every column is duplicated verbatim (.1 copies with identical distributions), which is a mechanical defect yielding zero added structure and signalling a broken pipeline. Beyond duplication, the set mixes two threads (meta rating-reliability vs. content complaint topic) rather than forming one clean faceted decomposition, and primary_complaint is ~64% NULL, weakening the one column that most directly serves the query's 'which aspect' need.
